context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs for P2 Policy UX Tooling are fully functional. Frontend ExecutionPoliciesPage has intermittent loading issue - page navigates correctly but content area doesn't render. The page was observed loading correctly in one screenshot (screenshot 20) but failed to load in subsequent tests. Check if there's a race condition or state management issue in the load() function.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend ExecutionPoliciesPage.jsx makes API calls in useEffect but the content area remains empty. The APIs return 200 with valid data (verified via curl). Possible causes: 1) isLoading state not being set to false, 2) payload state not being set correctly, 3) Race condition between API calls and render
